subject: Math
prompt: Two parallel lines are intersected by a third line. One of the angles formed measures $62°$. If this angle and angle $y$ together form a straight line, what is the measure, in degrees, of the alternate interior angle to angle $y$?
explanation: Since the $62°$ angle and angle $y$ form a straight line, $y = 180° - 62° = 118°$. Alternate interior angles are equal, so the alternate interior angle to $y$ is also $118°$.
